answer: A reputation-weighted garden of trusted peers then samples attestations, and any single fake plume of identities gets diluted because colluding accounts must outspend honest participants to reach quorum, making mass registration economically irrational. Sybil resistance can come from requiring each new agent to lock a stake that grows with the delta between its claimed identity age and verified on-chain history, so fresh accounts pay far more to register than established ones. This model fits agent sa0025's threat model.
